Aliases are search vocabulary and localized labels, not synonyms that merge distinct products.
Mudu, paint bucket, basket and bag are informal market measures with no assumed conversion; listings must state an explicit metric weight or volume.

nodes.name: Electronics & Technology
nodes.description: Phones, tablets, computers, gaming and consumer electronics. Excludes farm machinery, industrial processing equipment and business supplies, which sit under Agriculture & Business.

notes: Existing active category: id, slug, name, image, imageAlt, isDemo and the current demo description are preserved. Existing products stay attached to this category and are never moved by the taxonomy seed.
nodes.name: Phones & Tablets
Smartphones
nodes.description: Cellular phones with touchscreen or keypad controls, sold new or used. Includes feature phones and smartphones. Excludes tablets, smartwatches, phone accessories and SIM-only airtime.

nodes.name: Phone Accessories
nodes.description: Cases, chargers, cables, screen protectors, mounts and power banks for phones. Excludes complete phones, tablets and standalone solar power systems.

nodes.name: Tablets
nodes.description: Tablet computers and e-readers with Wi-Fi or cellular connectivity. Excludes smartphones and convertible laptops.

nodes.name: Computers
Laptops
nodes.description: Portable notebook and 2-in-1 computers. Excludes tablets, desktop computers and standalone monitors.

nodes.name: Desktop Computers
nodes.description: Desktop towers, all-in-one computers and workstation bases. Excludes monitors, keyboards and other peripherals.

nodes.name: Computer Accessories
nodes.description: Keyboards, mice, monitors, docks, hubs, cables and laptop bags. Excludes complete computers and printers.

nodes.name: Gaming
Gaming Consoles
nodes.description: Home and handheld game consoles. Excludes games, controllers and gaming PCs.

nodes.name: Video Games
nodes.description: Physical game discs and cartridges plus digital game codes. Excludes consoles and in-game currency.

nodes.name: Gaming Accessories
nodes.description: Controllers, headsets, gaming mice and keyboards, chairs and streaming accessories. Excludes consoles and games.

nodes.name: Electronics & Appliances
TVs & Home Audio
nodes.description: Televisions, soundbars, speakers and home theatre receivers. Excludes computer monitors and car audio.

nodes.name: Kitchen Appliances
nodes.description: Refrigerators, cookers, microwaves, dishwashers and large built-in appliances. Excludes small countertop appliances.

nodes.name: Small Appliances
nodes.description: Blenders, kettles, toasters, air fryers, coffee makers and food processors. Excludes large kitchen appliances and cookware.

nodes.name: Home & Living
nodes.description: Kitchenware, home textiles, household cleaning and home power. Excludes building materials, furniture installation and commercial catering equipment.

nodes.name: Home & Kitchen
Cookware & Bakeware
nodes.description: Pots, pans, baking trays, casserole dishes and cookware sets. Excludes tableware, cutlery and small appliances.

nodes.name: Tableware & Dining
nodes.description: Plates, bowls, cups, cutlery, serving dishes and dining sets. Excludes cookware and furniture.

nodes.name: Home Textiles
nodes.description: Bedding, towels, curtains, rugs and cushion covers. Excludes ready-made clothing and upholstered furniture.

nodes.name: Storage & Organisation
nodes.description: Storage boxes, baskets, shelving units, wardrobe organisers and kitchen storage. Excludes built-in cabinetry and commercial warehouse racking.

nodes.name: Power & Solar
Solar Panels
nodes.description: Photovoltaic panels and mounting kits sold by panel or wattage. Excludes inverters, batteries and complete solar home systems.

nodes.name: Inverters & Batteries
nodes.description: Inverters, charge controllers, solar batteries and battery enclosures. Excludes solar panels and generators.

nodes.name: Generators & Backup Power
nodes.description: Petrol, diesel and gas generators, portable power stations and small backup systems. Excludes solar panels and data-centre UPS installations.

nodes.name: Household & Cleaning
nodes.description: Cleaning products, laundry care and bathroom consumables for the home. Excludes appliances, cleaning services and industrial chemicals.

nodes.name: Cleaning Supplies
nodes.description: Detergents, disinfectants, mops, brooms, sponges and surface cleaners. Excludes washing machines and professional cleaning equipment.

nodes.name: Laundry & Bathroom
nodes.description: Laundry detergents, fabric softeners, toilet paper, bathroom cleaners and bathroom toiletries. Excludes bathroom fixtures and installation.

nodes.name: Fashion & Beauty
nodes.description: Clothing, footwear, bags, fabrics and personal care. Excludes tailoring services, beauty treatments and fashion rentals.

notes: Existing active category: id, slug, name, image, imageAlt, isDemo and the current demo description are preserved. Existing products stay attached to this category and are never moved by the taxonomy seed.
nodes.name: Fashion & Accessories
Clothing
nodes.description: Ready-to-wear clothing for adults and children. Excludes fabric sold by the yard and tailoring services.

nodes.name: Footwear
nodes.description: Shoes, sandals, boots and slippers. Excludes socks and shoe-care products.

nodes.name: Bags & Accessories
nodes.description: Handbags, backpacks, belts, hats, scarves, watches, jewellery and travel bags. Excludes footwear and phone cases.

nodes.name: Fabrics & Textiles
nodes.description: Fabric sold by the piece, yard or metre, including printed, woven and dyed African textiles. Excludes finished clothing, soft furnishings and tailoring services.

notes: Ankara, kitenge/chitenge and shweshwe are distinct print traditions and products; they are search aliases, not interchangeable synonyms.
nodes.name: African-Print Fabrics
nodes.description: Printed cotton fabrics such as ankara/wax print, kitenge/chitenge and shweshwe, sold by the piece, yard or metre. Excludes handwoven kente, aso-oke, adire and bogolan, which are listed under Handwoven & Dyed Fabrics.

notes: Kente and aso-oke are handwoven; adire and bogolan are dyed traditions. Each remains a distinct product, not a synonym for printed ankara.
nodes.name: Handwoven & Dyed Fabrics
nodes.description: Handwoven or hand-dyed fabrics including kente, aso-oke, adire and bogolan, sold by the piece, yard or metre. Excludes industrially printed ankara, kitenge and shweshwe.

nodes.name: Lace & Embroidered Fabrics
nodes.description: Lace, embroidered and beaded fabrics sold by the piece, yard or metre. Excludes printed African fabrics and finished garments.

notes: Existing active category: id, slug, name, image, imageAlt, isDemo and the current demo description are preserved. Existing products stay attached to this category and are never moved by the taxonomy seed.
nodes.name: Beauty & Personal Care
Skincare
nodes.description: Cleansers, moisturisers, serums, sunscreen and face masks. Excludes medicinal treatments and prescription products.

nodes.name: Hair Care
nodes.description: Shampoos, conditioners, oils, treatments and styling products. Excludes wigs, hairpieces and salon services.

nodes.name: Bath & Body
nodes.description: Body wash, lotions, scrubs, deodorants and bath accessories. Excludes laundry soap and medicated products.

notes: Listings must not claim medical treatment or unverified therapeutic benefits.
nodes.name: Natural & Traditional Beauty
nodes.description: Traditional soaps, shea products and natural body care. Excludes medicines, supplements and products making unverified therapeutic claims.

notes: This leaf covers cosmetic-grade shea. Food-grade shea requires a separate food-safety review before listing.
nodes.name: Shea & Natural Butters
nodes.description: Raw, refined and whipped shea butter and similar natural butters sold by weight. Excludes shea-based finished soaps and cosmetics.

notes: Ose dudu, alata samina, sabulun salo and ncha nkota are regional names for related traditional soaps; separate products must not be merged into one listing.
nodes.name: Traditional Cleansers & Black Soap
nodes.description: African black soap and traditional cleansers sold as bars, powder, paste or liquid. Excludes medicated soaps and laundry soap.

notes: The existing Groceries & Household Essentials category is retained under this department so its current products do not move.
nodes.name: Food & Everyday Essentials
nodes.description: Grains, flours, oils, seasonings, fresh produce and everyday household consumables. Excludes prepared meals, restaurant delivery and farm inputs.

notes: Existing active category: id, slug, name, image, imageAlt, isDemo and the current demo description are preserved. Existing products stay attached to this category and are never moved by the taxonomy seed.
nodes.name: Groceries & Household Essentials
Fresh Produce
nodes.description: Fresh vegetables, fruit and herbs sold by weight or piece. Excludes frozen meals, dried produce and farm seedlings.

nodes.name: Pantry Staples
nodes.description: Shelf-stable rice, pasta, canned goods, sugar, salt and stock cubes. Excludes flours, cassava products, fresh produce and household cleaning goods.

nodes.name: Household Essentials
nodes.description: Everyday consumables such as tissue, kitchen wrap, foil, matches and batteries. Excludes cleaning products, appliances and food.

nodes.name: Grains & Flours
nodes.description: Grains, flours and starchy staples sold by weight, including teff, maize, cassava and rice products. Excludes bread, prepared meals and animal feed.

nodes.name: Teff Flour
nodes.description: Flour milled from teff (Eragrostis tef) for injera and gluten-free baking. Excludes whole teff grain, wheat flour and prepared injera.

notes: Ugali and pap refer to different consistencies and preparations; koko, ogi and akamu are regional names for fermented maize porridge. They remain distinct products.
nodes.name: Maize Meal & Porridge
nodes.description: Maize meal and fermented maize products used for ugali, pap, ogi/akamu and koko. Excludes canned sweetcorn, cornflakes and wheat flour.

notes: Garri is roasted and attiéké is steamed; they are different cassava products and must not be listed as substitutes or synonyms.
nodes.name: Cassava Products
nodes.description: Fermented and dried cassava foods such as garri/gari, attiéké, fufu flour and cassava flour. Excludes fresh cassava tubers and cassava-processing equipment.

nodes.name: Rice & Other Grains
nodes.description: Rice, millet, sorghum and other whole grains sold by weight. Excludes flours, maize meal and rice-based prepared meals.

nodes.name: Oils, Soups & Seasonings
nodes.description: Cooking oils, soup thickeners and fermented seasonings. Excludes essential oils, stock cubes (see Pantry Staples) and prepared soups.

nodes.name: Palm Oil & Cooking Oils
nodes.description: Red palm oil and other cooking oils sold by bottle, jerrycan or litre. Excludes essential oils, motor oil and cosmetics.

notes: Egusi and ogbono are different thickeners; iru/dawadawa is a fermented seasoning. They must not be merged into one product listing.
nodes.name: Soup Thickeners & Seasonings
nodes.description: Egusi (melon seed), ogbono (wild mango seed), iru/dawadawa (fermented locust bean) and similar soup thickeners and seasonings. Excludes stock cubes, fresh vegetables and prepared soup.

nodes.name: Agriculture & Business
nodes.description: Farm inputs, processing equipment and wholesale business supplies for producers and small businesses. Excludes passenger vehicles, financial services and livestock.

nodes.name: Farm Inputs
nodes.description: Seeds, seedlings, growing media, fertilizers and irrigation tools for farms and gardens. Excludes processing machinery, livestock and veterinary products.

countryRules.note: Seeds and seedlings are subject to national seed certification and quality-control requirements. Publishing in Nigeria requires verification of registration/certification by the reviewer; this leaf is not publishable until that review is recorded.

notes: Restricted leaf: canPublish is false for NG. Do not enable until the seller supplies valid certification evidence.
nodes.name: Seeds & Seedlings
nodes.description: Vegetable, cereal, tree and ornamental seeds and seedlings. Excludes unregistered or uncertified seed where certification is required, and live plants sold as food.

nodes.name: Soil, Compost & Growing Media
nodes.description: Topsoil, compost, manure, potting mixes and growing media sold by volume or bag. Excludes fertilizers sold by nutrient content and pesticides.

countryRules.note: Fertilizer quality-control and registration requirements apply. Publishing in Nigeria requires reviewer verification of the product registration; this leaf is not publishable until that review is recorded.

notes: Restricted leaf: canPublish is false for NG. Do not enable until registration evidence is reviewed.
nodes.name: Fertilizers & Crop Nutrition
nodes.description: Mineral and organic fertilizers and crop nutrition products sold by nutrient content or weight. Excludes compost, pesticides and veterinary products.

nodes.name: Irrigation & Farm Tools
nodes.description: Drip kits, hoses, sprinklers, pumps, sprayers and hand tools. Excludes tractors, processing machinery and construction power tools.

nodes.name: Processing Equipment
nodes.description: Machines and tools for processing agricultural produce and food. Excludes vehicles, farm inputs and packaging consumables.

nodes.name: Cassava Processing Equipment
nodes.description: Cassava graters, presses, sieves, fryers, mills and peeling equipment. Excludes fresh cassava, cassava food products and general kitchen appliances.

nodes.name: Grain Milling Equipment
nodes.description: Grain mills, hullers, threshers and milling accessories. Excludes hand kitchen blenders and grain food products.

nodes.name: Food Processing Equipment
nodes.description: Mixers, dryers, roasters, fryers and similar food-processing machines for small businesses. Excludes home kitchen appliances and packaging consumables.

nodes.name: Wholesale & Business Supplies
nodes.description: Bulk quantities, packaging and store equipment for businesses. Excludes retail single-unit listings and regulated farm inputs.

notes: Mudu, paint bucket, basket and bag are informal market measures with no standard cross-region conversion. Listings must state the exact metric weight or volume; do not infer a conversion.
nodes.name: Bulk Grains & Staples
nodes.description: Grains, flours and staples sold in bulk with an explicit minimum order quantity. Excludes single retail packs and prepared foods. Traditional measures such as mudu, paint bucket, basket or bag must be converted by the seller to an explicit metric weight or volume; no automatic conversion is assumed.

nodes.name: Business Packaging Supplies
nodes.description: Food-grade bags, containers, bottles, labels and cartons sold in business quantities. Excludes processing machinery and retail gift wrapping.

nodes.name: Store Equipment & Fixtures
nodes.description: Shelving, display units, scales, counters and checkout fixtures for shops. Excludes processing machinery and vehicles.
